description: Legacy Recon is read-only static recon of a local codebase: point an agent at a directory and get (a) an architecture map (languages, packages, entry points, layering signals, file/size distribution), (b) a dependency + end-of-life risk list (manifest parsing plus a small explicit versioned-in-code EOL rules table; every EOL claim cites its rule id), and (c) modernization estimate INPUTS — LOC by language, test presence/ratio, manifest age signals, coupling hotspots by fan-in — raw inputs, never an estimate. Novel mechanism: evidence-bound recon. Every claim cites a file path plus the manifest line or structural fact it rests on; anything not determinable statically reports UNKNOWN with the reason, never a guessed stack; the dependency inventory keeps DECLARED (manifest), OBSERVED (import statements) and INFERRED (labeled inference with basis) in separate lists, never blended. Safety: target code is never executed or imported, symlinks are never traversed (escapes are reported), binary files are skipped and counted, and size/file-count caps surface as named truncation flags. Free, services-led: every recon is a qualified modernization lead for CETech's legacy modernization line.
